items.title: myEgo
items.description: Collaboration with Maika Sontrop (MADtech, Frank Mohr Institute) on their graduation performance myEgo. I built a microphone system worn on the body. The final performance was with Maika Sontrop and Riley Huang.
items.fullDescription:
myEgo is Maika Sontrop’s graduation performance (MADtech, Frank Mohr Institute). I worked on it with Maika and Riley Huang.

I built the microphone system worn on the body: small capsules and cabling running along the arms, torso, and legs, so movement and contact become the sound of the performance.

The final performance was with Maika Sontrop and Riley Huang.
items.themes: Collaboration, graduation performance, the body as an instrument

items.title: Hackathon with Huba de Graaff
items.description: Hackathon with composer Huba de Graaff during Soundsofmusic 2024. I worked with tape machines and old sound carriers with MADtech, then showed the setup at the Frank Mohr Institute.
items.fullDescription: I took part in a hackathon led by composer Huba de Graaff during Soundsofmusic 2024. With MADtech at the Frank Mohr Institute in Groningen, we worked with reel-to-reel recorders, tape loops, and other old sound carriers, then presented the setup in the festival exhibition.
items.technical: Tape machines, loops, pre-digital sound carriers

items.title: Gesture-Controlled Performance System for Slow Music
items.category: GESTURE INTERFACES • LIVE A/V • EMBODIED SYSTEMS
items.description: A modular gesture-driven audiovisual system where the body becomes the instrument—G.C.P.S.S.M. (Gesture-Controlled Performance System for Slow Music) extends it into released audio.
items.fullDescription: MediaPipe and TouchDesigner map body movement to real-time sound and generative visuals. First shown at Fever Dream; since then it has served as a modular live A/V platform—gestures drive glitch and drone textures, pulses, and projections—with an intentionally slow, embodied approach to control and coding. G.C.P.S.S.M. (Gesture-Controlled Performance System for Slow Music) is the slow-music branch of this system: gesture and speed control rework older material as samples, released on asymmetrica.
items.medium: Gesture interfaces, real-time sound/visual generation, sensor-based interaction, ambient performance systems
items.technical: MediaPipe, TouchDesigner, Python, real-time audio synthesis, custom control pipelines
items.themes: Embodied computation, glitch aesthetics, slow music, gesture-controlled performance, poetic control systems
